name: Documented public goals used by AIR
note: Statements below are limited to wording checked against the linked sources. This list is editable. It is not a ranking of governments, and a project that does not touch these goals is not a failed project.

goals.name: SDG 7 — Affordable and clean energy
goals.statement: Ensure access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all. Target 7.1: by 2030, ensure universal access to affordable, reliable and modern energy services.

goals.name: SDG 13 — Climate action
goals.statement: Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts.

goals.name: SDG 9 — Industry, innovation and infrastructure
goals.statement: Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation.

goals.name: SDG 6 — Clean water and sanitation
goals.statement: Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all.

goals.name: SDG 2 — Zero hunger
goals.statement: End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture.

goals.name: SDG 11 — Sustainable cities and communities
goals.statement: Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable.

goals.name: SDG 12 — Responsible consumption and production
goals.statement: Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns.

goals.name: Paris Agreement temperature goal
goals.statement: Holding the increase in the global average temperature to well below 2°C above pre-industrial levels and pursuing efforts to limit the temperature increase to 1.5°C (Article 2.1(a)).

goals.name: UAE Consensus — renewables and efficiency by 2030
goals.statement: Calls on Parties to contribute to tripling renewable energy capacity globally and doubling the global average annual rate of energy efficiency improvements by 2030 (Decision 1/CMA.5, paragraph 28(a)).

goals.name: UAE Consensus — transitioning away from fossil fuels
goals.statement: Calls on Parties to contribute to transitioning away from fossil fuels in energy systems, in a just, orderly and equitable manner, so as to achieve net zero by 2050 in keeping with the science (Decision 1/CMA.5, paragraph 28(d)).

goals.name: IEA Net Zero by 2050 pathway
goals.statement: The IEA Net Zero by 2050 roadmap is a pathway for the global energy sector to reach net zero CO2 emissions by 2050.

goals.name: Global Methane Pledge
goals.statement: Participants commit to work together to collectively reduce global anthropogenic methane emissions across all sectors by at least 30 percent below 2020 levels by 2030. This is a collective target, not a per-country quota.

goals.name: Universal energy access by 2030
goals.statement: SDG target 7.1: by 2030, ensure universal access to affordable, reliable and modern energy services.
